Class ElmIdentity

java.lang.Object
network.ike.foundation.ike.elm.ElmIdentity
public final class ElmIdentity extends Object
Identity for what a library becomes, derived and never random (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1110). A library's seed is its id and nothing else: the CQL version string is data on its identity record, so successive CQL versions become STAMP versions of the same semantics. A definition's seed is its library, its kind, and its name, with operand types for an overloaded function. An unnamed list item's seed is its library and what it contains. A list's seed is the definition and the position path it fills. A reference's seed is the definition and what it names.
